precision_invariants: FP32 logsumexp accumulation; preserve dtype-specific output cast and baseline verifier. Parallel reduction changes accumulation order and requires all-case precision validation.

Canonical frozen golden uses torch cross_entropy: all-ignored mean producesNaN, whereas baseline serial path returns0. This static source divergence needs a hardware correctness guard; preserve NaN/Inf behavior.
semantic_invariants: For each N/spatial position use stable logsumexp across C minus selected logit; ignore_index contributes zero and is excluded from mean denominator.
Reduction none returns position losses; sum/mean combine all valid positions. Integer targets outside valid labels or ignore_index must be rejected before device indexing.
Class axis is dimension1, so inner=product(shape[2:]); row gather and output ordering must preserve N/spatial layout.
